name: B10-0253/2026 (ESN) – The cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of human rights and environmental defenders Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi in Indonesia
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns acid attacks on two Indonesian activists, Andrie Yunus and Muhammad Rosidi. It calls on Indonesia to investigate thoroughly and independently, punish those responsible, and protect the victims and their families. It also raises concerns about corruption, violence against religious minorities, and local laws that restrict religious freedom and free speech. Separately, it welcomes a new trade agreement between the EU and Indonesia, saying it will strengthen the EU's economic position in the region. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing directly; the Parliament asks Indonesia to investigate the attacks and protect the victims.
- **Who it affects:** The two activists, their families, and Indonesia's authorities and courts.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and to Indonesia's president, government and parliament.
